## Outcome

<!-- One sentence: what changes for a user or operator, and why. -->

## Issue or spec

<!-- Use `Fixes #123`, an HTTPS URL, or `inline` when the acceptance criteria below are the complete spec. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Each criterion must describe observable behavior or an invariant. Add or remove rows as needed. -->
- AC-1: <observable behavior or invariant>

## Evidence

<!-- Cover every AC-N with the exact command or scenario and its observed result. -->
- AC-1 — command/scenario: `<exact command or user path>`; observed: `<result>`

## Scope

- In: <behavior, files, or subsystems included>
- Out: <explicit non-goals, or `none`>

## Risk and rollback

- Level: <low|medium|high>
- Failure mode: <what could go wrong>
- Rollback/mitigation: <revert, migration, containment, or `not applicable`>
- Reviewer focus: <specific assumptions, files, or questions>

## Accountability and agent provenance

- Accountable human: @<GitHub handle>
- Origin: <human|assisted|agent-authored|authorized-automation>
- Agent identity: <none|tool or GitHub App identity>
- Provider/model: <none|provider and exact model when available>
- Run/trace: <none|immutable run ID or sanitized trace URL>
- Base SHA: <none|40-character protected-base commit>
- Capabilities: <none|commands=...; network=...; secrets=...; mcp=...>
- Human verification: <what the accountable human personally reviewed and exercised>

## Human attestation

- [ ] I am or represent the accountable human named above.
- [ ] I reviewed every changed line and can explain why it is needed.
- [ ] I personally verified the behavior and evidence described above.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the project's license.
- [ ] This is not an unattended agent submission; I remain responsible for the contribution.
